reviews.author: Sumran Talreja
reviews.body: I recently bought the Kusho Dreamer Cervical Pillow and I’m really happy with it. The pillow gives very good support to my neck and head, and I wake up with much less neck stiffness now. The memory foam feels soft but still supportive, which makes it comfortable for sleeping on both the back and side. I also like that the pillow keeps its shape and doesn’t go flat like regular pillows. The cover fabric is soft and breathable, so it feels comfortable even during warm nights. Overall, it has improved my sleep and neck comfort. I would definitely recommend it to anyone who has neck pain or spends long hours working on a laptop.
